ValidationRule.description: Role, Segment, Vertical, Mailing City & Mailing State must be input before Partner Contact can move to Refer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Partner", OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c,"Refer"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c,"Loyal")), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Role__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Segment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Vertical__c)), ISBLANK(MailingCity), ISBLANK(MailingState) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Role, Segment, Vertical, Mailing City & Mailing State must be input before Partner Contact can move to Refer.
